description: PROPOSED (issue #107 / Discussion #108, not yet normative): Strict validation covers every closed object in resultset.json, not only the top level: an unknown key inside `provider`, `runner`, `summary`, `group` and `Result.error` is each rejected with UNKNOWN_FIELD. The `summary.scenarios` and `error.detail` shapes come from real adapters the Discussion #108 impact sweep found (agenteval-openeval-adapter and ares-openeval-adapter put that data there instead of under `metadata`). Provider parameters such as a seed belong in the open `provider.extra`.
